speedster.briefing: Full speed on asphalt and grass. Scan survivor at 17 m with camera. Slow near 20 m, cross the 3.5 cm step at 22-26 m gently, then full
speedster.rationale: Speedster fits this short, mostly flat course. The small battery covers about 20 s of driving, and the camera handles the survivor scan at 17 m. The only risk is the step, so the driver slows briefly there and runs fast elsewhere.

partsWhy.why: Needed to scan the survivor at 17 m; avoids a 10 s penalty.
Spots the step 3 m ahead so the driver can slow down.
Highest top speed; torque is enough for a flat track.
Enough energy for 40 m, and cheaper and lighter.

mud_crawler.briefing: Go fast. Camera-scan the survivor at 17m as you pass. Slow a little before the step at 22m, cross it straight on, then full speed to 40m.
mud_crawler.rationale: The preset fails on the brief: the survivor zone at 17 m needs a camera or scout drone, and the crawler has only an IMU. A missed zone costs 10 s (40 pts), so a 35 EUR camera is worth it. The IMU stays to feel the step. Tracks, torque motor and large battery are kept.

partsWhy.why: Needed to scan the survivor at 17 m; skipping it costs 10 s.
Clears the 3.5 cm step and holds grip on grass and asphalt.
Feels the step impact and any slip on the grass.
Plenty of energy for 40 m, so no risk of failing to finish.

all_rounder.briefing: Fast on asphalt. Camera-scan the survivor at 17m on grass. Slow for the 3.5cm step at 22m, then full speed to the 40m finish.
all_rounder.rationale: The all-rounder already fits. The camera can scan the survivor at 17 m, so no zone is missed and no 10 s penalty. Off-road wheels handle grass and the step. The bumper halves impact damage at the step. No part fails, so nothing changes.

partsWhy.why: Scans the survivor at 17 m and reads terrain ahead.
Halves impact damage at the 3.5 cm step.
Grip on grass, extra clearance for the step.
Cheap warning for the step ahead.

deep_diver.briefing: Full speed on asphalt. Scan survivor with camera near 17m on grass. Slow for the 3.5cm step at 22-26m, then full speed to 40m.
deep_diver.rationale: The track has no water, so the case and thrusters are dead weight. But nothing in the brief makes a part fail, so I kept the preset as asked. The camera covers the survivor scan at 17 m and the ultrasonic can see the step. The driver is told to slow for the step.

partsWhy.why: Needed to scan the survivor at 17 m; a missed zone costs 10 s.
Detects the 3.5 cm step ahead so the driver can slow down.
Ample energy for 40 m; no range risk.
Torque for grass and the step; kept from the preset.
